question: Where is the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Mountaineering and Allied Sports situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manali, Himachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Mountaineering and Allied Sports** is situated in Manali, Himachal Pradesh__.
 
• This institute is one of the premier mountaineering and adventure sports institutes in India.
 
• It offers a range of courses in mountaineering, skiing, trekking, and other allied sports.
 
• The institute is named after **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**, the former Prime Minister of India, in recognition of his contributions to promoting adventure sports in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is known for its picturesque landscapes and is a popular destination for adventure sports enthusiasts.
 
• The state offers numerous opportunities for outdoor activities such as mountaineering, rock climbing, paragliding, and river rafting.
 
• The institute not only trains individuals in various adventure sports but also promotes safe and responsible practices in these activities.
 
• It plays a crucial role in developing skilled professionals who contribute to the adventure tourism industry in India.
